name: @wildflowerhealthio/fhir-r4-adoption
description: The FHIR R4 side of extraction: a resource a source decoded, detached from that source, and a detached resource adopted into the device's store. detach(family) drops a resource's id, keys it by that id as identifier[0] in the system its SystemFamily gives its type, and turns each literal reference to another record into a logical reference by the target's key; DetachedResource is that shape (id null, keyed by its first identifier) and reads its key; adopt stores a keyed record under the id its key derives and a keyless one under a minted id, and resolves each logical reference by key to a literal one; adoptedReferenceOf spells one such reference from outside its source, and originalIdOf reads the source's id back off one. No DOM, no fs, no React.
